name: Improved Outflank [Combat, Selfless, Teamwork]
body:
You can easily find openings in your enemies’ defenses.

Prerequisite(s): Outflank, base attack bonus +6.

Benefit(s): Whenever you and an ally are threatening the same foe, your ally is considered to be flanking that foe if they are adjacent to an unoccupied square from which they would be able to flank the foe with you.

Normal: Your ally must be positioned opposite you to flank an opponent.
